en: Colorized historical postcard view of a narrow street leading toward a tall round stone tower with a dark dome roof. Old plastered houses with red-tiled roofs flank the lane, one with an arched wooden gate in the foreground. Leafless tree branches frame the scene on the left, and a small signboard hangs beside a wooden fence. The sky is bright blue with a single small cloud. Printed caption text appears in the upper right.
